svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Dropouts: two 60 x 60 mm pieces of 6 mm plate. Slot each from the

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: bottom edge: 12.2 mm wide, round end 30 mm up (the axle centre).

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: The left one carries a caliper tab 75 x 60 mm on its rear edge.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Set them 135 mm apart inside (motor axle width) on a dummy axle.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Upper stays (2): 22 x 1.6 tube about 290 mm, from the rail end cap

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: (centred 35 mm up the cap) to the dropout's front edge, 2 mm below

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Lower stays (2): about 282 mm, from the rear cross member's rear face

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: (35 mm in from the rail's outer face, 13 mm up) to the dropout,

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Each stay's dropout end is slotted 6 mm to take the plate; trim any

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: tube inside the plate's inner face so the hub fits.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Caliper tab: drill the two post-mount holes with the caliper and rotor
